findings.consequence: Distinct SKUs sharing a title are submitted arbitrarily, contrary to the ambiguity/no-write contract.
findings.preferred_fix: Group matches by canonical SKU; return ambiguity without writes for distinct IDs and submit only a unique SKU, deduplicating repeated rows.
findings.rationale: One uniqueness owner repairs behavior without downstream name resolution or a speculative registry.
findings.compatibility: Keep submit_sku and its current client; no cleanroom removal.

findings.consequence: Documentation treats infrastructure failure as no-match and can encourage the wrong resubmission.

findings.rationale: Correct concise recovery instructions rather than adding a second retry policy.
findings.compatibility: No API change; cleanroom is irrelevant.

findings.consequence: Checked route omits its terminal event at attempt 4.

findings.rationale: Remove one duplicated side-effect policy, not move both loops or add boolean combinations.

findings.rationale: Centralize demonstrated field ownership instead of duplicating constructors behind new modules.
